How the odds are scored

A weighted heuristic, not a prediction. It favours roles where a real employer is actively screening right now — those convert. It is honest about what it cannot see: undisclosed salary is marked as estimated, never implied to be in band. No resume goes into this number — it is the same for every visitor. Yours moves the match column instead, and never leaves your browser.

Weighting

Where these come from

Naukri and LinkedIn job boards, plus employers' own Workday systems — the Workday rows are direct requisitions with no agency in between.

Salary bands are marked Stated when the employer published a range and Est. when it was inferred from the experience band. Always verify CTC before investing time in an application.
